CAUSE: DTW alignment requires DtwParameters to be set at WhisperContext creation time, not at inference time
FIX: Added dtw_preset_for_model() in whisper.rs that maps model IDs to DtwModelPreset enum values, then passes DtwParameters to context builder
FILE: src-tauri/src/features/transcription/whisper.rs

PATTERN:
```rust
fn dtw_preset_for_model(model_id: &str) -> Option<DtwModelPreset> {
    // maps "small", "base", "tiny" etc. → DtwModelPreset::Small etc.
    // returns None for unknown/quantized models → skips DTW
}
// Applied at context creation, not at inference
```
